summary: Design practical sales playbooks, CRM workflows, metrics, and coaching routines for B2B and B2C teams. Build your implementation plan with TrainingCred.
lede: Designing high-performance sales and customer operations playbooks turns commercial strategy into repeatable workflows, decision rules, service standards, and coaching routines. This course connects field sales, inside sales, digital acquisition, contact-centre activity, and account management through customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, CRM workflows, and clear pipeline stages. You will build practical playbook components, including role maps, handoff checklists, pipeline taxonomies, funnel and cohort measures, and CRM-informed coaching cadences. You will also apply MEDDIC for complex B2B opportunities, use RFM analysis where suitable, and map complaint escalation with ISO 10002 guidance while keeping workflows adaptable to your organisation’s tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own customer acquisition, account growth, service operations, or sales enablement and need to convert commercial priorities into repeatable team routines. It suits beginner to intermediate practitioners who understand their customer and sales environment but need a structured method for creating and implementing a sales playbook.
modules: Sales Playbook Foundations and Operating Context
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to sales, customer operations, account management, customer experience, or CRM-based reporting. No coding is required, and you do not need prior experience with a specific CRM platform. Bring one anonymised sales process, customer journey, account workflow, or KPI report for application during exercises where organisational policy permits. Advanced digital topics such as AI-assisted forecasting and CRM automation receive operational application treatment. You will assess use cases, data requirements, controls, and adoption implications rather than engineer or deploy production systems.
